coordinate_system.primary_axis: X shaft axis in main_view; equivalent shaft-axis direction is labelled Z in several detail and section notes.
coordinate_system.orientation_notes: The part is a turned shaft. Main-view X is axial and Y is radial. Transverse/detail views use their local radial directions for groove and spline details. Coaxial features are interpreted about the common shaft axis defined functionally by datum pair Z1-Z8.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: Most runout controls reference the combined Z1-Z8 datum axis, defined by the left centre hole face and the Ø71.476 bearing journal. Datum K6 is the angled right face used for the spline tooth flank profile control. Datum P1 is defined on the OD of the left external spline in Section A-A and appears as a local datum/inspection reference for that spline profile.

component_specs.extraction_notes: This table is structured with two columns of values for two different sets of tooth data ('Verz. V2' and 'Verz. V1'). The values have been combined with a pipe '|' delimiter to capture both in a single row object, as the schema expects one entry per parameter row. Some symbols like 'α', 'β', 'a', 'z', 'mn' are embedded in the value cells rather than a dedicated symbol column.

component_spec_links.link_notes: The gear table tooth data includes z=48 and mn=2.0, matching the right external spline/geared section noted in the main view as similar to DIN 5480 W100x2x48x12F. Detail W gives tooth flank/helix correction, and the T sketch/detail features give tooth edge-break information for the same gear/spline tooth zone. The separate left SAE 10C 10-tooth spline does not match this table.

assumptions.text: Grouped main_view:F2, section_aa:F1, and section_bb:F1 as the same left external spline using the A-A and B-B section-cut references. section_aa:F1 was chosen canonical because it contains the spline profile dimensions, tooth count, surface finish, and datum P1 definition.

Grouped main_view:F3 with detail_u:F1 as the Ø52/K7 cylindrical surface because Detail U is called out on the Ø52 transition area and detail_u:F1 carries the K7 surface label. main_view:F3 was chosen canonical because it contains the explicit Ø52 diameter and GD&T.

Grouped main_view:F7 with detail_w:F1 and the T-sketch tooth edge-break features because these detail views describe corrections and edge conditions of the right gear/spline tooth zone rather than independent part features. main_view:F7 was chosen canonical because it contains the principal diameters, GD&T, and DIN 5480 reference.

Did not group main_view:F1 with detail_x despite a reused Detail X label, because the extracted detail_x section describes right-hand external groove/cylinder/taper geometry rather than the left conical centre hole. The drawing contains multiple X callouts, so feature-type and geometry consistency were prioritized over the duplicate label.

Left the E1/E3 and E2 relief-groove detail features as separate feature observations despite similar A1.2 dimensions, because their view labels indicate distinct groove locations and no parent feature in the main view unambiguously identifies them as the same physical groove.

Assigned unattached main-view baseline length callouts UC1 through UC8 and UC10 to isometric_view:F1 as global shaft/body axial dimensions because the extraction did not create individual shoulder-face nodes for each baseline target.
Assigned unattached callout UC9 to main_view:F5 because the 11 +0.5 dimension is located with the radial cross-hole callout cluster and most plausibly locates the stepped cross-hole feature.

Assigned unattached chamfer/angle callouts UC11 and UC12 to main_view:F7 because they are in the right-hand gear/spline end-region callout cluster and no separate main-view chamfer feature was extracted there.

Assigned unattached radius callouts UC13, UC14, and UC15 to main_view:F4 as transition radii for the stepped-cylinder region, since their labels appear in the central stepped-shaft area and no individual radius nodes were extracted in the main view.

Accepted the transcribed Detail X dimensions as authoritative despite the extraction note that the Ø94.5 groove bottom appears visually inconsistent with the adjacent Ø94 cylinder; no identity merge was made that would force those values to conflict.
The Ø8 portion of the stepped radial through-hole extends from the outer diameter (Ø71.476 h5) to the central axis of the shaft, where it transitions to the Ø6 portion at the centerline.
